title: Ep. 134: Why Programmatic Advertising Needs a Reset
synopsis: Featured guest breaking down the realities of programmatic advertising, CTV transparency, and how lessons from traditional linear TV buying still apply to modern digital environments.

title: Why Amazon and YouTube pitched operating systems, not just TV inventory at this year's upfront
synopsis: David gives his take on the 2026 Upfronts, specifically analyzing Amazon's 90% U.S. household coverage claim and their authenticated audience graph.

title: TV Was Never Built to Behave Like Meta
synopsis: Authored essay arguing that forcing Connected TV into performance marketing frameworks designed for search and social ignores television's unique value.

title: Performance vs. Reality: What Actually Drives Digital Growth Today
synopsis: Live interview at POSSIBLE Miami where David brings a pragmatic operator's lens to breaking down how performance is really measured and where measurement breaks in digital growth.

title: Why Streaming Ads Underperform On Paper As Measurement Misconceptions Persist
synopsis: Explains why CTV looks underwhelming when measured exactly like search, and how to appropriately rethink performance in a multi-device world.

title: The Cost of Keeping Quiet: Ad Fraud, Incentives & The Silence Protecting Billions
synopsis: David joins Sarah Caputo to discuss the persistence of media waste and why ad fraud isn't just a technology problem, but an incentive problem.

title: Peer39 Interview Series: David Nyurenberg, SVP of Digital at InterMedia Advertising
synopsis: Following the Brand Safety Summit, David unpacks the industry's misplaced priorities, the challenges of measuring true brand safety in streaming, and the need for transparency.

title: InterMedia Group of Companies Strengthens CTV Leadership with Appointment of David Nyurenberg
synopsis: Announcement of his appointment as SVP of Digital at InterMedia Advertising, crediting him as a respected industry voice driving AI transformation across linear and streaming media.

title: Advertisers put SSPs and curators under the microscope in sell-side push for ad tech fee transparency
synopsis: Quoted discussing how his team separates tech, audience, and platform fees from working media spend to ensure dollars are actually making it to publishers.

title: How This Indie Agency Is Finding 'Back Doors' To Get Show-Level Data On CTV
synopsis: Interviewed on how Rain the Growth Agency navigated the opaque landscape of CTV ad buying by developing an algorithm with Chalice Custom Algorithms to extract show-level data for programmatic bids.

title: The Trade Desk is rolling out OpenPath to CTV
synopsis: Quoted as the Associate Director of Digital Video at Rain the Growth Agency, providing media buyer perspectives on the performance-yielding benefits of OpenPath for Connected TV (CTV).

title: Trust Web Times Interview Series: David Nyurenberg
synopsis: An in-depth interview exploring Nyurenberg's early career at Gameloft, his time at programmatic managed service vendors, and the founding of his self-funded consultancy Valor.
